title: Position Compensation
text: Compensate for position offset due to different types of delays, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Nature of offset} sets Type of offset Sample; {Offset value} sets the position offset value, {Number of sample delay} sets the number of block execution time samples, {Discrete step size (s)} sets the sample time after which block executes again, {Cut-off frequency (Hz)} sets the filter cutoff frequency, {Position unit} sets the unit of position, {Speed unit} sets the unit of angular velocity and {Maximum application speed (RPM)} sets the upper limit of angular velocity. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Nature of offset
params.values: Type of offset Sample delay (default) | Constant delay | External delay | High-pass filter delay | Low-pass filter delay

params.name: Number of sample delay
params.values: Number of block execution time samples 1 (default) | scalar

params.name: Discrete step size (s)
params.values: Sample time after which block executes again 50e-6 (default) | scalar

params.name: Position unit
params.values: Unit of position input Radians (default) | Degrees | Per unit

params.name: Speed unit
params.values: Unit of angular velocity input RPM (default) | Degrees/Sec | Radians/Sec | Per unit

params.name: Maximum application speed (RPM)
params.values: Upper limit of angular velocity 4000 (default) | scalar
